name: celebrai-event-planner
description: CelebrAI: an AI event planner with guest lists, RSVPs and budgets. React + Express + Supabase + Ollama Cloud GLM-5.3.

scripts.install:all: node -e "for (const d of ['server','client']) require('fs').rmSync(d + '/node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
